notes: Standard 2 paper (Caringbah High School 2022 HSC trial, Ms Stephens 12MAS), treated as AT4. Section I Q1-15 (15 marks), Section II Q16-39 (85 marks): sums verified (Booklet 1 = 55, Booklet 2 = 30). Solutions come from the separate scanned file 824 (handwritten, no marking criteria, so marks_breakdown is null); MCQ key from its cover page. Paper typo: Q23 prints 'greater than 21.5 g and less than 18.5 g is rejected'; 'and' should be 'or' (transcribed as printed; fix = 'or'). Paper typo: Q28c 'least-squares regressions line' (regression). Solutions file differences: its Q26 says 4 marks and Q27 says 5 marks (paper: 3 and 4, parts 1+2 and 2+2) and its cover total is amended to 101; the paper's marks (total 100) are used. Handwritten solution to Q33c says 'if she sells 10 coffee tables' while the stated intersection is (18, 3600); solution transcribed with 18 (the correct break-even, 200n = 360+180n). Q38 handwritten arithmetic: total repaid 14258.76 and interest 2258.77 are as written (1782.34 x 8 = 14258.72). Q36 solution has two figures: hand-drawn tree and the green highlight on the printed network. Q19 diagram part a is a blank diagram to complete (question figure) with the completed hand drawing as the solution figure. Q36a, Q32a, Q33b and Q19a ask for drawings. Tables in Q9, Q27, Q29, Q32, Q38 and the spreadsheet in Q31 are embedded images, stored as cropped figures.
